types.description: Comma-delimited OTX indicator types to fetch

max_pages.description: Maximum OTX pages fetched in one plugin run

max_indicators.description: Maximum normalized indicators emitted in one plugin run

max_retries.description: Retry attempts for transient OTX page fetch failures (timeouts, HTTP 5xx incl 504, connection errors). Auth/4xx errors fail fast. attempts = max_retries + 1.

backoff_ms.description: Base retry backoff in milliseconds; bounded exponential (factor 2) with equal jitter, capped at 30000ms

min_pull_interval_ms.description: Self-throttle window: a fresh OTX pull runs at most once per this interval (default ~24h) even if the agent runs the check more often. Set 0 to disable throttling. Partial (paged) walks always resume regardless of this window.
